I'm pulling the key details from the delivery note: it's document DN-260910-656 dated 2026.09.10, tied to PO 4500318713, covering 11,000 pieces of Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5 in 11 boxes, with a total weight of 99 kg shipped by Nordhav Shipping A/S and stamped with the red HWASEONG seal.

I'm going through the delivery note's quantities and stamps now: the 11,000 pieces and 11 boxes are readable even though the seal and star overlap parts of the table, so I'll record them as clear and note the overlap. The receipt stamp dated 19.10.2026 goes in as the received date, while the shipped date stays the document date, and I'm leaving the receiver signature and remarks as blank.

I'm weighing whether to include the received stamp as a stamp note, since it isn't really a correction but the schema covers stamp notes. The receiving date of 19.10.2026 is about forty days after the note date, which is worth noting neutrally. The receiver signature line is blank, which stands out, so I'm leaning toward calling the document clean with that as an observation.

The receiver signature line is empty, and so is the remarks (비고) field.

No prices appear on the note.
The page is clean, with no visible damage.
